description: This file configures and initializes an Axios HTTP client instance for API communication, including utility functions for handling base URLs, environment configurations, token management, and interceptors for request authorization and refresh token handling.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slash(es) from a URL or path string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1'.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is the Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL in the Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable base URL values for consistency.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL based on environment variables and environment context.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL.

methods.name: formatAuthorizationHeaderValue
methods.description: Prepares the Authorization header value, ensuring correct bearer prefix.

methods.name: extractTokensFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from API response data.
